methodology.notes: This submission uses a multi-agent system: a coordinator agent talks to the customer and delegates each task to specialist sub-agents, which call the standard τ²-bench tools and return results to the coordinator. The agent-side prompts and system instructions are our own; the standard τ²-bench tasks, tools, user simulator and evaluator are used unchanged. 4 trials per domain, seed 300.

verification.details: Modified the agent system prompt to support the multi-agent framework. No questions were omitted.
